root_cause.text: The permission check in `nsfs_fh_to_dentry` was insufficiently restrictive because it only verified `ns_capable(owning_ns, CAP_SYS_ADMIN)`, allowing privileged services to open file handles and access namespaces belonging to other privileged services.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the check `if (owning_ns && !ns_capable(owning_ns, CAP_SYS_ADMIN))` in `fs/nsfs.c` was replaced with `if (owning_ns && !may_see_all_namespaces())` to tighten permission checks and prevent information leaks between privileged services.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the file handle support for nsfs, including the vulnerable `nsfs_fh_to_dentry` function. Specifically, lines 528-531 contain the insufficiently restrictive permission check: `if (owning_ns && !ns_capable(owning_ns, CAP_SYS_ADMIN))`, which only verifies if the caller has CAP_SYS_ADMIN in the owning user namespace, allowing privileged services to access namespaces belonging to other privileged services.
